id.description: The id of the {@link UiSdlDiagramShape}. Used to index the derived shape map sent to SDLDiagram.

renderFunctionKey.description:
A component level specification of the function that should be used to render the shape.
It is expected that framework specific implementations transform this into a real function and populate
{@link #renderFunction}. (See {@link UiSdlDiagramReact} for an example).

renderFunction.description: A function that when given {@link #renderProps} as input will render the shape as HTML.

renderProps.description:
All of the data needed to correctly render a shape on the diagram. Will be passed into the {@link #renderFunction}
when rendering the shape corresponding to {@link #id}.

title: A type that contains all of the data required to render a {@link UiSdlDiagramShape} on a {@link UiSdlDiagram}.
name: UiSdlDiagramShapeRenderData
